Content: When the cats collect the specified amount of cheese, all rats will be unable to transform for a short period, and an arrow will be generated that randomly points to one rat.

When the rats individually collect the specified amount of cheese, they can consume cheese to cast Stealth, becoming invisible for a short period. While holding cheese, all rats earn points faster but have reduced Movement Speed.
The cats have activated their faction skill. Rats cannot transform for {0}s.
